info.name: Tofimotia API - Venue Booking Platform
info.description:
Complete API documentation for Tofimotia - A comprehensive venue booking platform that allows users to discover, book, and manage venue reservations.

## Features:
- User registration and authentication with JWT tokens
- Role-based access control (USER, VENDOR, ADMIN)
- Venue management and search capabilities
- Booking system with availability checking
- Real-time booking status updates

## Base URL: https://tofimotia-backend.onrender.com

## Authentication:
Most endpoints require JWT authentication. After login, the token is automatically saved and used for subsequent requests.

## Getting Started:
1. Register a new user account
2. Login to get JWT token
3. Explore venues and create bookings
4. Manage your bookings and profile
